name: Creamy Macaroni Salad with Bell Pepper, Carrot & Celery
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool; add to the bowl. Stir to combine the macaroni salad.
To serve, divide macaroni salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
